description: Find House and Senate bills in one session by title, number, type, chamber, status, or indexed MP sponsor. Sponsor results are the OpenParliament-indexed subset; fetch a bill for its sponsor, stages, divisions, and statute citation. Omitted session means the verified current official session. Follow nextOffset with identical filters.

billCode.description: Exact bill code, including a split-bill suffix letter such as C-15A; accepts bill s321, S321, S 321, or S-321.

billType.description: Official bill type from canparl_list_reference topic bill_types.

limit.description: Maximum rows, default 25, effective cap 100; values through 10000 are accepted and clamp with a notice. Whole records may end the page early at the 24000-byte response budget; follow nextOffset.

offset.description: Zero-based offset in the selected ordering.

originatingChamber.description: House, House of Commons, or Senate; case-insensitive.

sponsor.description: MP OpenParliament slug or politician path/HTTPS URL (member.slug from canparl_get_member, or an includeFormer canparl_search_members row), or a current MP's official personId; Senators are not indexed. A digit-only value equal to a current personId, or its /politicians/<digits>/ path or profile URL, is read as that personId.

status.description: Official bill status from canparl_list_reference topic bill_statuses.

titleContains.description: Literal case-insensitive substring of any English or French long or short title.

name: canparl_search_bills

appliedFilters.description: Normalized filters applied together with AND.

billCode.description: Canonical exact bill code, or null.

billType.description: Canonical official bill type, or null.

sponsor.description: Verified canonical OpenParliament sponsor slug, or null.

sponsorName.description: Name on the verified OpenParliament sponsor profile, or null.

titleContains.description: Trimmed literal title filter, or null.

bills.description: Matching official bills ordered by chamber prefix, number, then split-bill suffix letter.

billCode.description: Canonical House or Senate bill code.

chamber.description: Chamber of the latest completed major stage, or null; royal assent is reported as Senate.

name.description: Latest completed major stage name, or null.

latestMajorStage.description: Latest completed major stage, or null.

en.description: English text, or null when unavailable.

fr.description: French text, or null when unavailable.

royalAssentDate.description: Royal assent as a UTC instant ending in Z (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS[.fraction]Z), or null; a value in another shape is relayed as published.

en.description: English text, or null when unavailable.

fr.description: French text, or null when unavailable.

cap.description: Effective page limit after the per-call cap.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `unknown_session`: Session malformed or absent from the official bill session index. `invalid_bill_filter`: Malformed bill code, chamber, or sponsor slug, or unrecognized type or status. `sponsor_not_found`: Sponsor slug has no profile of its own, or a current personId has no unique verified OpenParliament profile. `sponsor_scan_incomplete`: The bounded ten-page sponsor scan still has a continuation. `upstream_blocked`: An official parliamentary source refuses the request with HTTP 403. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Limit clamp, coverage, empty-result, past-end, or response-budget guidance.

pagination.description: Local continuation in the filtered ordering, including a response-budget stop.

limit.description: Effective maximum rows after the per-call cap.

nextOffset.description: Next offset, or null when exhausted.

provenance.description: Original retrieval metadata from all source requests.

cached.description: Whether this response came from the in-memory cache.

shown.description: Number of bills in this page.

sponsorCoverage.description: Whether the result is restricted to the third-party sponsor index.

total.description: Exact matching count after all filters and before pagination.

truncated.description: Whether more matching bills remain after this page.

title: Canparl Search Bills
